citation: Garet, M. S., Cronen, S., Eaton, M., Kurki, A., Ludwig, M., Jones, W., Uekawa, K., Falk, A., Bloom, H. S., Doolittle, F., Zhu, P., & Sztejnberg, L. (2008). The Impact of Two Professional Development Interventions on Early Reading Instruction and Achievement (NCEE 2008-4030). Washington, DC: National Center for Education Evaluation and Regional Assistance, Institute of Education Sciences, U.S. Department of Education.
design: School-level cluster RCT (3-arm: Treatment A institute series, Treatment B institute series + coaching, business-as-usual Control); 90 schools / 6 districts / 270 grade-2 teachers / ~5,055 students randomly assigned within district in equal numbers; subject = early reading; grade 2 (registry K-2). Impacts estimated via 3-level HLM (students in teachers in schools), pretest/covariate-adjusted.
problems: Report frames a single 3-arm study with two PD treatments vs one shared control; registry rows 32/33 ('study 1'/'study 2') are mapped to Treatment A (institute only) and Treatment B (institute + coaching), each contrasted vs the same control. Authors report the model-based standardized impact as the 'effect size' (d) with its SE; J small-sample correction is ~1.000 at the achievement sample df so g==reported ES. ICC / design-effect not reported as a single value (3-level HLM used instead), so icc left null per spec (never guess). Tests differ across the 6 districts (TerraNova/CTBS in 4, SAT-10 in 1, criterion-referenced state test in 1) but standardized within district and pooled; all are commercial/state standardized reading tests (primarily comprehension) -> standardized_independent. Teacher-knowledge and instructional-practice outcomes (ES 0.37/0.38 etc.) are NOT student achievement and were skipped.

effect_sizes.arm_label: study 1 = Treatment A (8-day content-focused institute & seminar series, LETRS) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: District-administered standardized reading test (total reading score), standardized within district to the 2004-2005 baseline-cohort SD; tests = TerraNova/CTBS (4 districts), SAT-10 (1 district), criterion-referenced state test (1 district)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's model-based standardized impact (d = 0.08) taken directly as the ANCOVA/HLM effect size; standardized by within-district SD of the 2004-2005 baseline grade-2 cohort. Hedges J = 1 - 3/(4*df-1) with df = n_t+n_c-2 = 3448 gives J=0.99978, so g = J*d = 0.0800. g_se = J*impact_se = 0.08; g_var = g_se^2. SE taken from report's 'Standard Error of the Estimated Impact'.
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.51, Table 4-3 (Test Score standardized effect size, 'Institute Series Only vs. Control'); also Exec Summary Fig E-3 (xxx) and p.50 text
effect_sizes.notes: Immediate post-intervention (Implementation Year Spring 2006). Impact ES = 0.08, SE = 0.08, p = 0.37 (not significant). Group means (regression-adjusted, standardized): Treatment A = 0.08, Control = 0.01. n_clusters = 30 treatment-A schools + 29 control schools = 59 (1 control school missing student data; analysis N = 89 schools, 5,055 students total across all 3 groups). Follow-up Year (Spring 2007) ES = 0.10 (Table 5-3, p.61) - later wave, not extracted as primary. A secondary dichotomous outcome (% at/above baseline mean) gave +3.48 pp (SE 3.57, ns) but is a percentage-point measure, not an SMD, so not used for g.

effect_sizes.arm_label: study 2 = Treatment B (institute & seminar series + in-school coaching) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: District-administered standardized reading test (total reading score), standardized within district to the 2004-2005 baseline-cohort SD; tests = TerraNova/CTBS (4 districts), SAT-10 (1 district), criterion-referenced state test (1 district)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's model-based standardized impact (d = 0.03) taken directly as the ANCOVA/HLM effect size; standardized by within-district SD of the 2004-2005 baseline grade-2 cohort. Hedges J = 1 - 3/(4*df-1) with df = n_t+n_c-2 = 3264 gives J=0.99977, so g = J*d = 0.0300. g_se = J*impact_se = 0.09; g_var = g_se^2. SE taken from report's 'Standard Error of the Estimated Impact'.
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.51, Table 4-3 (Test Score standardized effect size, 'Institute Series Plus Coaching vs. Control'); also Exec Summary Fig E-3 (xxx) and p.50 text
effect_sizes.notes: Immediate post-intervention (Implementation Year Spring 2006). Impact ES = 0.03, SE = 0.09, p = 0.77 (not significant). Group means (regression-adjusted, standardized): Treatment B = 0.04, Control = 0.01. n_clusters = 30 treatment-B schools + 29 control schools = 59. Follow-up Year (Spring 2007) ES = 0.01 (Table 5-3, p.61) - later wave, not extracted as primary. Secondary dichotomous outcome (% at/above baseline mean) gave -2.35 pp (SE 3.78, ns) - percentage-point measure, not an SMD, not used for g. Treatment B vs Treatment A (added effect of coaching) on the achievement test ES = -0.05 (ns) - not a TPD-vs-control contrast, not extracted.
